goal: Globale Suche bis zu Feldwerten separat auf Basis des I153-Fundstellenvertrags planen, inklusive Datentypumfang, Read-only-Invarianten und späterer Deep-Gate-Grenze.

guide_delta.summary: I154 plant Datentypen, Ergebnisvertrag, Query-Schutz und Implementierungsreihenfolge für spätere Feldwerttreffer, ohne Runtime oder Repository zu ändern.

tests_explicitly_not_run: search product tests because no runtime search code changes
storage tests because no repository code changes
Chromium tests because UI is unchanged
risks: typed values require deterministic searchable and display representations
choice values can create duplicate rows unless deduplicated per entry/field
later repository implementation touches protected CP-06 scope and must use deep gate
expected_side_effects: global field-value search has a bounded implementation contract
future implementation is explicitly deep-gated when repository code is touched
